title: introduce-credential-strategy-and-stream-adapter-unification-with-sdk-version-sync
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs had duplicated credential retry wiring and inconsistent streaming ergonomics which made cross-language examples brittle and caused support overhead. This PR extracts a minimal credential strategy surface (CredentialStrategy) used by Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, and introduces a StreamAdapter shim that normalizes generator/pull-stream and async-iterator semantics to a single ergonomic surface. The change reduces duplicated auth-stateful retry plumbing, centralizes retry presets, and paves the way for coordinated version bumps across the three SDKs. What this PR does: 1) Add CredentialStrategy interface and light implementations: StaticTokenStrategy, LeasePoolStrategy, and FallbackCascadeStrategy (with explicit backoff presets). 2) Add StreamAdapter which exposes a unified pull/generator/async-iterator API and provides cancel/heartbeat hooks and optional resume tokens. 3) Centralize retry preset map (named: conservative|balanced|aggressive) and wire defaults into credential flows. 4) Add small compatibility shim in the hosted runtime client to consume the unified streams without changing runtime surface. 5) Bump SDK package versions: python 1.12.0, typescript 2.9.0, go v1.8.0 and update changelogs. 6) Integration tests and cross-language examples updated (samples/pullstream-cred.md). Risk and mitigation: migration is additive for most customers; existing credential factories are supported via an adapter layer. We added an opt-in flag enableCredentialStrategy to allow staged rollout. Rollout plan: feature flagged on beta for internal customers for two weeks, then enable-by-default after telemetry review. See linked Linear tickets for follow-ups.
